title: Ankhorage Dependency Graph
summary: Analyzes project dependencies and produces canonical Ankhorage graph data with source evidence.
purpose: Provide project-aware dependency topology that other tools can inspect without coupling analysis to a visualization or package-mutation workflow.
responsibilities: Detect project boundaries used during dependency analysis.
Analyze dependency relationships and retain evidence for produced graph data.
Project analysis results into the canonical graph model.
boundaries: Does not own Cytoscape visualization or user-interface rendering.
Does not execute dependency updates, rollbacks, or package-manager mutations.
Does not own GitHub repository transport.
audience: Architecture and developer tools that need inspectable dependency topology.
Consumers of canonical Ankhorage graph data.
useCases: Analyze a project and obtain its dependency graph.
Inspect evidence behind source and dependency relationships.
Feed project-aware topology into graph or architecture tooling.

architecture.role: Reusable analysis library between project detection and the canonical graph boundary.
invariants: Analysis results use canonical graph data rather than visualization-specific models.
Repository transport and update execution remain outside the analysis core.
